title: A status entry has Staff, Date and Time and can be searched
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, active (it already has its creation entries in Part History).
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL STATCOL PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-STATCOL-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-STATCOL-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL STATCOL PART).
  3. Check the setup worked: [Part-A]'s Part History already lists at least one entry.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  2. Open [Part-A]'s Part History.
  3. Type "deactivated" in the Part History search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The "Deactivated" entry fills Staff, Date and Time like every other entry on the page.
  • Step 3: The "Deactivated" entry is listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
